text: Yes, the tree cover on this asset has remained unchanged since 2020. The evidence shows **no detectable tree-cover loss** (above 0.5 ha) between 2021 and 2025. While some tree cover was present in 2000 (48.4 ha) and classified as forest in 2020 (43.3 ha, 11.55% of the asset), no significant loss events were identified in the latest data (up to 2025). The analysis accounts for changes down to 0.5 ha, so small or edge-based changes may not be captured, but no major losses are confirmed.
